Author:     Daniel Darnell <daniel@thunderbird.net>
AuthorDate: Tue Jul 16 08:48:37 2024 +0000
Commit:     Daniel Darnell <daniel@thunderbird.net>
CommitDate: Tue Jul 16 08:48:37 2024 +0000

    Bug 1904390 - Fix StartupWMClass for ESR Flatpak builds. r=rjl
    
    Differential Revision: https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D216231

diff --git a/taskcluster/docker/recipes/build_desktop_file.py b/taskcluster/docker/recipes/build_desktop_file.py
index 65ed76eeb81..42a538e6300 100644
--- a/taskcluster/docker/recipes/build_desktop_file.py
+++ b/taskcluster/docker/recipes/build_desktop_file.py
@@ -76,10 +76,13 @@ def build_template(
     locales: List[str],
     fluent_resources: List[str],
     is_beta: bool,
+    is_esr: bool,
 ):
     wmclass = "thunderbird"
     if is_beta:
         wmclass = wmclass + "-beta"
+    elif is_esr:
+        wmclass = wmclass + "-esr"
     locales_plus = locales + ["en-US"]
     l10n_strings = FluentTranslator(l10n_base.resolve(), locales_plus, fluent_resources)
 
@@ -140,6 +143,13 @@ def main():
         default=False,
         help="Mark this build a beta version",
     )
+    parser.add_argument(
+        "--esr",
+        dest="is_esr",
+        action="store_true",
+        default=False,
+        help="Mark this build an ESR version",
+    )
 
     args = parser.parse_args()
 
@@ -151,7 +161,13 @@ def main():
     get_strings(args.l10n_base, comm_l10n_rev, args.fluent_files)
 
     build_template(
-        args.output, args.template, args.l10n_base, locales, args.fluent_files, args.is_beta
+        args.output,
+        args.template,
+        args.l10n_base,
+        locales,
+        args.fluent_files,
+        args.is_beta,
+        args.is_esr,
     )
 
 
diff --git a/taskcluster/docker/tb-flatpak/repack.sh b/taskcluster/docker/tb-flatpak/repack.sh
index 02ffa9e5418..fed4a1c7cde 100755
--- a/taskcluster/docker/tb-flatpak/repack.sh
+++ b/taskcluster/docker/tb-flatpak/repack.sh
@@ -65,13 +65,16 @@ done
 
 # Download artifacts from dependencies and build the .desktop file.
 (
+[[ "$FLATPAK_BRANCH" = "stable" ]] && VERSION_FLAG="--esr" || VERSION_FLAG="--beta"
 source "${SCRIPT_DIR}/venv/bin/activate"
-python3 "${SCRIPT_DIR}/build_desktop_file.py" -o "${WORKSPACE}/org.mozilla.Thunderbird.desktop" \
+python3 "${SCRIPT_DIR}/build_desktop_file.py"               \
+  -o "${WORKSPACE}/org.mozilla.Thunderbird.desktop"         \
   -t "${SCRIPT_DIR}/org.mozilla.thunderbird.desktop.jinja2" \
-  -l "${WORKSPACE}/l10n-central" \
-  -L "${WORKSPACE}/l10n-changesets.json" \
-  -f "mail/branding/thunderbird/brand.ftl" \
-  -f "mail/messenger/flatpak.ftl"
+  -l "${WORKSPACE}/l10n-central"                            \
+  -L "${WORKSPACE}/l10n-changesets.json"                    \
+  -f "mail/branding/thunderbird/brand.ftl"                  \
+  -f "mail/messenger/flatpak.ftl"                           \
+  $VERSION_FLAG
 )
 
 # Generate AppData XML from template, add various
